_note: Hand-maintained aliases. NOT machine-generated — safe to edit, and expected to change a few times a year.
_mergeInto: page path → existing record id. The site re-lists a returning web series on a new page each season and sometimes drops the old path (the old page becomes a nav-only stub). List every page that describes the SAME record here: those pages are treated as already-known (never ingested as new items) and are used by the refresh pass as fallback URLs when a record's own pageUrl stops working. Episodes/embeds are unioned into the target record, so nothing is ever lost.
_skipPaths: Same as data/aliases.json: alternate URLs of titles already stored — never ingested.

families._note: Series that return every year. A newly discovered series whose title matches a family is checked against that family's existing records and merged into the matching one instead of creating a near-duplicate.
